requireAccount.title: No trainer account yet

confirmTransfer.title: Confirmation needed
confirmTransfer.warning: OAK does not put these Pokémon on a transfer list without your confirmation. Only tick what you really want to let go. OAK never transfers anything itself.

empty.title: No Pokémon imported yet

dashboard.title: Overview

noGameData.title: No Game Data
noGameData.text: Without Game Data, species names, levels, PvP analyses and cleanup advice are not available. Update the Game Data under Admin.

resources.title: Stardust & Candy
resources.description: Stardust and items come from PGSharp. PGSharp does not export Candy per species; you can track it here yourself.

history.title: History
history.description: Differences between consecutive syncs. Pokémon that disappeared are called 'no longer in inventory': OAK does not know whether they were transferred.

box.title: Pokémon Box
box.description: All Pokémon from the latest sync. Actions here only change OAK data, never the game.

filters.flagHint: Click: only these → exclude these → no filter

syntax.title: Search syntax
syntax.intro: Terms are combined with AND. Spaces or & separate the terms.
syntax.name: Name, nickname or form contains the text
syntax.cp: Compare CP or give a range
syntax.extras: Costume, background, traded, new, no longer in inventory

empty.title: No Pokémon found
empty.text: Change the search or filters, or import an export first.

tagDialog.title: Add OAK tag
tagDialog.hint: OAK tags are separate from the tags in Pokémon GO and change nothing in the game.

compare.title: Compare
compare.description: IV rank per league is the rank within the species; the species rank comes from PvPoke.

empty.title: Choose 2 to 6 Pokémon
empty.text: Select Pokémon in the <boxLink>Pokémon Box</boxLink> and choose Compare.

planner.title: Evolution and investment planner
planner.description: Choose a goal and a budget. OAK finds the Pokémon where your Stardust pays off most. Your Candy stock is unknown, so check it yourself in the game.
planner.none: No candidates within these limits. Raise the budget or the maximum IV rank.
planner.footer: Priority follows suitability (PvPoke species score × IV quality). The cost of TMs, evolution items and unlocking a second move is on the detail page.

rules.moveTypeNone: No Pokémon with a move of type {{types}}.

rules.distanceNone: No Pokémon with a buddy distance of {{distances}} km.

stages.final: final stages of an evolution line

cups.title: Cups
cups.description: Special formats with their own rules, such as the Fantasy Cup. OAK shows the cups PvPoke currently has on its site. These include GO Battle League cups as well as community tournaments. Pokémon GO itself shows which cup is running in the game.
cups.emptyText: The active Game Data contains no cups. Update the Game Data under Admin and OAK fetches them from PvPoke.
cups.unrankedHint: Your Pokémon are sorted by IV rank only.
cups.eligible: {{species}} species and forms are allowed under PvPoke's rules.

league.cupRulesSource: As PvPoke describes them. Check in the game whether the cup is running now and whether the rules are the same.
league.emptyCup: No Pokémon fit this cup (after evolution or power-up), or the analysis still has to run.
league.emptyLeague: No Pokémon fit this league (after evolution or power-up), or the analysis still has to run.
league.truncated: You see the first {{shown}} of {{total}} Pokémon in this order. Sorting covers all {{total}}.
league.explanation: Click a column header to sort. Species rank says how strong the species is (PvPoke). IV rank says how good this Pokémon is within its species. A strong IV rank in a weak species does not make a good battle Pokémon.

teamBuilder.title: Team Builder
teamBuilder.description: Three team variants from your own collection: ready now, with limited upgrades, and the best future team.

raids.title: Raids
raids.description: Without a boss you see your best general attackers. Pick a raid boss for counters against that specific opponent.
raids.search: Search for a raid boss, e.g. kyogre
raids.intro_one: The attacker with the highest DPS using its current moves. Click a column header to sort within this list. The number shows its DPS rank.
raids.intro_other: The {{count}} attackers with the highest DPS using their current moves. Click a column header to sort within this list. The number shows their DPS rank.
raids.alreadyBest: Current moveset is already the best

rocket.title: Team GO Rocket
rocket.description: Pick the Pokémon of the grunt, leader or Giovanni. For each opponent, OAK finds the best counters in your own collection.
rocket.noLineups: OAK has no validated, dated source for current Rocket lineups, so it makes no claims about them. You pick the opponents yourself.

max.title: Max Battles
max.description: Dynamax and Gigantamax Pokémon from your collection, their Max Moves and what an upgrade costs.
max.search: Search for a Max Battle opponent
max.emptyText: The export contains no Pokémon with Dynamax or Gigantamax status.

gyms.title: Gym defenders
gyms.description: The Pokémon that hold a gym the longest: lots of HP and Defense, so an attacker needs many attacks. Your strongest Pokémon of each species.

excluded.notDeployable: {{number}} may not go in a gym according to the Game Data
excluded.unknownForm_one: {{number}} has a form the Game Data does not know
excluded.unknownForm_other: {{number}} have a form the Game Data does not know

gyms.emptyText: Your collection has no Pokémon that may go in a gym according to the Game Data.

accounts.title: Trainer accounts
accounts.description: Every Pokémon GO account gets its own trainer account in OAK, with its own webhook and data.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.maxDropPercentHint: If the number of Pokémon drops by more than this percentage, OAK treats the import as partial.
accounts.unlinkConfirm: Forget the link with the Pokémon GO account? Only use this if you deliberately want to link a different account to this trainer.
accounts.deleteText: All OAK data of this account is removed: Pokémon, notes, tags, plans, imports and history. Your Pokémon GO account itself does not change. Type {{name}} to confirm.

backups.ownerOnlyText: Only the owner of this OAK installation can manage backups.
backups.title: Backups
backups.description: OAK automatically makes a backup before every database migration. Here you can make one yourself and download it.
backups.restoreText: Stop the container, replace /data/oak.db with the backup and start the container again. A full backup of the /data folder also contains the secret key and saved exports. See docs/BACKUP_RESTORE.md.

gamedata.title: Game Data
gamedata.description: Game data with version control. A new version only becomes active after it has been checked. Previous versions are kept so you can go back.
gamedata.repairNeeded: The file of the active version is missing. Choose Update now to rebuild it.
gamedata.upToDate: The active version is up to date.
gamedata.updateStarted: Update started. OAK downloads, checks and activates the new version in the background.
gamedata.versionActivated: Version activated. Analyses are being recalculated.
gamedata.noActiveText: Without Game Data, OAK cannot calculate species names, levels, PvP ranks or cleanup advice. The Pokémon themselves are still imported.
gamedata.lastErrorText: {{error}} The active version was not touched.
gamedata.offlineText: If the server has no internet access, download the files elsewhere and upload them here. OAK checks them the same way as a download.

rules.title: Cleanup rules
rules.text: Favorites get extra keep points but no hard protection. Pokémon from 2016 through 2019 are always protected as vintage. You set weights, thresholds and the other protection rules per trainer account.

sprites.title: Pokémon images
sprites.saved: Saved. Reload the page to use the new security settings for images.
sprites.none: No images (dex number and type color)
sprites.templateHint: Must start with https:// and contain {dex}. {shiny_path} becomes 'shiny/' for shiny Pokémon.
sprites.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.

tags.title: In-game tags
tags.saved: Tag saved. The cleanup analysis is being recalculated.
tags.intro: PGSharp only exports the number of a tag, not its name. Name your tags here and choose which tags protect a Pokémon from cleanup advice.
tags.none: No tags found in the last import.
tags.name: Tag name

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions have been signed out.

reset.title: Reset password for {{name}}
reset.text: Give the user the new password through a secure channel. They can then change it themselves under Settings. All sessions of this user end immediately.
reset.done: New password set for {{name}}. They have been signed out everywhere and sign in with the new password.

users.title: Users
users.note: Each user only sees their own trainer accounts. You change your own password under Change password, with your current password.

sync.title: PGSharp Sync
sync.description: Connect PGSharp with a webhook or upload an export. Both routes use the same processing.

webhook.title: PGSharp webhook
webhook.urlLabel: Webhook URL (the secret part is never shown again)
webhook.none: There is no active webhook for this account yet.
webhook.regenerateConfirm: A new URL makes the current one invalid. PGSharp then needs the new URL. Continue?
webhook.revokeConfirm: Revoke the webhook? PGSharp can then no longer send anything to this account.
webhook.secret: The URL works like a password. Do not share it and keep it out of screenshots.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostic mode (24 hours)
diagnostics.active: Active until {{date}}. OAK stores the full structure of every incoming export, without values.
diagnostics.inactive: Useful when an import fails. OAK then records the field names and types of every export, never the content.

setup.title: Set up PGSharp
setup.step1: Create a webhook URL in the PGSharp webhook card and copy it.
setup.step2: In PGSharp, open the settings and look for the option to export account data.
setup.step3: Paste the URL into the webhook for Export Account Data.
setup.step4: Start an export. After a few seconds the import appears below.
setup.step5: If the webhook does not work, export the file PGSStats.json and upload it here.
setup.note: The exact names of the menu options in PGSharp can differ per version. OAK never asks for your Pokémon GO login details.

upload.title: Manual upload
upload.duplicate: This export was already received. Nothing has changed.
upload.received: Upload received. Processing runs in the background.
upload.drop: Drag PGSStats.json here or click to choose a file
upload.samePipeline: The file goes through the same processing as the webhook.

schema.title: Export structure
schema.newRootKeys: New fields in the root structure

confirmFull.title: Was this a full export after all?
confirmFull.text: OAK treated this import as partial, so missing Pokémon were not marked as gone. If you are sure you really transferred Pokémon in the game, confirm that the export was complete.
confirmFull.confirm: Confirm that this export contains your full inventory? Missing Pokémon then get the status 'No longer in inventory'.

list.title: Imports
list.emptyText: Send an export from PGSharp or upload a file.

pokedex.description: Look up any Pokémon from the Game Data. See what it can do, whether you already have it and which Pokémon in your collection can evolve into it.

empty.text: Type a name or a Pokédex number. You don't need to own the Pokémon.

pokedex.noAccount: Create a trainer account to see what your collection can do with this Pokémon.
pokedex.source: Source: the active Game Data, version {{version}}. The rankings come from PvPoke.

scenario.title: Calculate as
scenario.explanation: Purifying puts a Shadow Pokémon at level 25, or at your trainer level if that is lower, and gives every IV 2 extra points up to 15. This cannot be undone, and you cannot lower a level. A Pokémon can become too strong for Great League as a result.

purify.summary: After purifying: level {{level}}, IV {{ivs}}, CP {{cp}}. Purifying costs {{stardust}} stardust and {{candy}} candy.

analysis.title: Battle analysis
analysis.noTarget: No suitable form for this league.
analysis.ivNote: A Pokémon with excellent IVs is not automatically a good battle Pokémon: also look at the species rank and readiness.

evolutions.title: Evolutions
evolutions.eliteWarning: Note: some moves of this evolution can only be learned with an Elite TM.
evolutions.note: A higher CP alone is never a reason to evolve. Compare the league ranks.

powerUps.title: Power-ups
powerUps.candyUnknown: Your candy stock is unknown: PGSharp does not export it.

cups.title: Cups
cups.none: This Pokémon does not fit any of the cups PvPoke currently shows, not even after evolution.

cleanup.description: Explainable advice on which Pokémon to keep, build up or transfer. OAK never transfers anything itself.

protection.title: Hard protection
protection.text: Whatever is turned on here always gets 'Protected', however low the scores are. If you turn a rule off, the trait only counts as points in the keep score.

keep.title: Keep score (0–100)
keep.text: Every trait counts once. IVs only count through usefulness. Favorites get extra points but no hard protection.
